run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the position of the rightmost set bit in an integer
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use n.bit_length() or n & -n for finding the rightmost set bit
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses bitwise left-shift to locate the least significant 1-bit
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the 1-based position of the rightmost set bit of n
